releaseNotes:
## Weekly overview

- Choose which sections appear in the Weekly view: guest rooms, conference and meeting rooms, staff rooms, notes, meals, and allergies.
- Choose Weekly print sections independently from the on-screen view.
- Select individual staff rooms for both the Weekly view and printout.
- Set the printed Notes row height from 5–40 mm to leave space for handwritten notes.
- Remember screen and print preferences separately for each user.

## Printing

- Print layout now recalculates room-row space from the sections and staff rooms included.
- Print in colour or black and white from the same compact print dialog.
- Restore recommended print defaults or copy the current on-screen section choices with one click.
